keyEvents.text: Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Paris FC 1, Nice 0. Lassine Sinayoko (Paris FC) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Paris FC 1, Nice 0.
Second Half begins Paris FC 1, Nice 0.
Goal! Paris FC 2, Nice 0. Samir Chergui (Paris FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ilan Kebbal.
Substitution, Nice. Elye Wahi replaces Nathan Ngoumou.
Substitution, Paris FC. Rudy Matondo replaces Moses Simon.
Delay in match because of an injury Pablo Pagis (Paris FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Paris FC. Patrick Zabi replaces Pablo Pagis because of an injury.
Substitution, Nice. Isak Jansson replaces Axel Witsel.
Substitution, Nice. Antoine Mendy replaces Mohamed Abdelmonem.
Substitution, Nice. Hamza Koutoune replaces Jonathan Clauss.
